narrative_shape: A long assembler implementation that actually lands edits, then a late park. Through turn 165 the worker fixes alldata_writer field layout, switches has_bmt to content-driven, writes files, and reports tests passing. Edit count then freezes at 14. Turns 173–180 are only a monitor wait for a background Perth extraction before build_alldata and compare_disc. That wait is the end state (last checkpoint 180, T=192).

phases.name: implement and first verify
phases.note: Edits 3→12 on alldata_writer. Turn 74 fixes bsmr_offset; turn 90 pastes exact field lengths; turn 120 says it builds and moves to decode-back.

phases.name: corrections, tests, e2e prep
phases.note: has_bmt reconsidered and smoke re-run. Writes appear. Turn 161 tests pass. Turn 165 starts waiting on a background suite while prepping the Perth fixture.

phases.name: parked on extraction monitor
phases.note: No new edits or reads. Tail is four versions of waiting for the Perth extraction monitor before compare_disc.

Matching field lengths and writing the exact strings after a value dump.

rationale: Progress is real through the early window. The turn-120 verify sentence is the foreshadowing. The monitor park itself is after 120 and is the outcome, so it is not listed as an early signal.
